title: Fruit Box Sort
description: Sort colorful fruit boxes in a relaxing puzzle game. Plan your moves and fill matching containers.
instructions: Desktop: left-click boxes and buttons. Mobile: tap boxes and buttons.

title: Formula Apex Rush
description: Race Formula cars across 8 regions and 40 events. Upgrade your car and become Apex Champion.
instructions: WASD to move.

title: PocketGolf
description: A minimalist golf challenge drawn in a hand-made paper style. Sink the hole in as few strokes as possible.
instructions: Desktop: click and drag away from the ball to aim, then release. Mobile: touch and drag, then release to shoot.

title: Blocktrail 2048
description: Collect blocks, grow your number trail and chase down weaker rivals to steal their points.
instructions: Use the mouse, WASD or arrow keys to move. Press Space to boost.

title: Nutty Rush Kart
description: Pick a racer, build your kart and race through colourful tracks across eight worlds.
instructions: W or Up to accelerate; A and D or arrows to steer; S or Down to brake. Space or Shift to drift.

title: Rim Rebels 3v3
description: Take the blacktop in full-court street basketball. Play the CPU or jump into an online match.
instructions: Move with WASD or arrows. Shoot with J or Space, pass with K and use Shift to turbo. Touch and gamepad are supported.

title: Color Coin Merge
description: Sort and merge colored coins, discover patterns and use power-ups to clear the board.
instructions: Place colored coins in slots and merge them. Use the Hammer, Free Move, Shuffle or Time Slot power-ups.

title: Panda Run 1
description: Jump, slide, dodge obstacles and collect coins across four different biomes.
instructions: Use WASD to move the panda.

title: Mecha Screw 3D
description: Take apart colorful machines, remove exposed screws and fill matching color boxes.
instructions: Click or tap exposed screws to remove them. Use Hint, Undo, Magnet or Drill when needed.

title: Snake VS AI
description: Slither across a bright 3D island, draw loops to claim territory and compete against AI snakes.
instructions: Steer with the mouse, WASD, arrow keys or a touchscreen.

title: Goods Sort Match Puzzle
description: Drag goods between shelves and line up three identical items to clear them.
instructions: Click and drag or touch and drag items to empty slots. Match three identical goods on the same shelf.

title: Cage Ballers Football
description: Step into the cage for a fast, small-sided football match against the CPU.
instructions: WASD or arrow keys to move, Shift to sprint, Space to shoot, E to pass and Q or Tab to switch players.

title: Turbo Boat Runner 3D
description: Take control of a speedboat, collect coins and race through the waves while avoiding obstacles.
instructions: Use WASD to move and control your boat.

title: Crazy Cart
description: Push and balance a cart filled with colorful shapes. Collect and transport objects without dropping them.
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play.

title: GT Rush 2026
description: Race GT cars on three circuits, with championships, drifting and upgrades.
instructions: WASD to move.

title: Netherton Volleyball
description: Call the shots for a whole volleyball team in a quick pixel-art game.
instructions: Click or tap when the ring turns green. On a keyboard, use Space for the tap and Q, W, E, A, S or D to set.

title: Ocean Dash
description: Dive into the deep sea to catch fish, collect rewards and watch out for sharks.
instructions: Use A, D, S and W to move.

title: Carletto Halloween Dreams
description: Guide Carletto through a Halloween dream of floating islands, haunted forests and glowing castles.
instructions: Use the left and right arrows or A and D to move. Jump with Space, Up or W. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.

title: Furious GT Drift
description: Drift through floating arenas, complete missions and upgrade your cars.
instructions: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move.

title: Stunt Witch 3
description: Help a little witch recover stolen stars. Steer through glowing rings and dodge bats.
instructions: Use the arrows, A and D, the mouse or touch to steer. On mobile use the on-screen buttons.

title: Referee Simulator 3D
description: Run with play, make the calls and use the pitchside VAR monitor to review incidents.
instructions: PC: WASD or arrow keys to move, Shift to sprint and mouse to choose decisions. Mobile: drag to run and tap the buttons.

title: Bus Master: Road Journey
description: Get behind the wheel of a bus and explore city streets, highways and challenging roads.
instructions: Use W or Up to accelerate, S or Down to brake, and A and D to steer.

title: Mud Trails 4x4 Jeep Game
description: Drive a 4x4 jeep across muddy tracks, rough terrain and challenging off-road routes.
instructions: Use W or Up to move forward, S or Down to reverse, and A and D or the arrows to steer.

title: Castle Story Match3!
description: Help a young princess bring her ruined castle back to its former glory in a match-three puzzle game.
instructions: Match three or more identical items, then spend the coins earned to restore the castle.

title: 6x6 Offroad Jeep
description: Take control of a 6x6 off-road jeep and navigate rugged mountain trails.
instructions: W or Up to accelerate; S or Down to brake or reverse; A and D or arrows to steer; C to change the camera.

title: Simulator GT Motorsport
description: Pick and upgrade cars, then take on circuit, short race, drag race and drift modes.
instructions: WASD to move.

title: Castle Crashers: Stolen Sun
description: Choose an elemental knight and follow a fantasy adventure across a kingdom robbed of daylight.
instructions: WASD or arrows to move, J to strike, K for skill, and Space to jump. Mobile controls are available.

title: Car Carrier Truck: Highway Master
description: Drive a transport truck, carry cars across challenging roads and complete delivery missions.
instructions: Use W or Up to accelerate, S or Down to brake and A and D to steer.

title: FPS Block Strike Dust2
description: Choose your team and take part in a block-style team-based FPS battle.
instructions: Move with WASD or arrows, use the mouse to aim and shoot, and press B to open the market.

title: Nitrovenant 2
description: Drive through hordes of zombies in an armored car, jump obstacles and upgrade your vehicle.
instructions: A and D or Left and Right to change lanes; Space or W to jump; hold R for nitro.

title: DONT SPLASH
description: Jump from tile to tile through a foggy abandoned pool and find the exit without falling in.
instructions: Move with WASD, look with the mouse, jump with Space and run with Shift. Mobile controls are also available.

title: SPOOKY BOXING
description: Choose from a cast of monsters and battle through spooky boxing arenas.
instructions: Use A and D or arrows to move, W to guard and Z, X or C to attack. Mobile players can use the on-screen buttons.
